newsitem.title: USA: Muni yields rise up to 15 basis points over week.
newsitem.headline: Muni yields rise up to 15 basis points over week.

text.p: Municipal bond yields jumped as much as 15 basis points over the week ended Thursday on top of similar increases the week before, Delphis Hanover Corp said Friday.
Treasury market yields moved similarly higher over the week. The long bond rose 11 basis points, to 7.15 percent at the close Thursday.

Thirty-year Aaa-rated municipal yields rose 15 basis points over the week, to 5.85 percent, Delphis said. Thirty-year Baa yields also rose 15 basis points for the second week in a row to 6.65 percent.
In the intermediate sector, ten-year Aaa-rated muni yields were up 10 basis points to 5.05 percent. Baa-rated 10-years also rose 10, to 5.85 percent.
Average yields on one-year Aaa-rated municipal bonds were up five basis points to 3.85 percent and Baa-rated one-years moved 15 higher to 4.65 percent.
The Aaa municipal yield curve steepened 10 basis points, moving to 200 basis points. The spread between one-year and 30-year Baa's was unchanged at 200 basis points.
The credit spread between Aaa-rated and Baa-rated one-years widened 10 basis points to 80 basis points, and the 30-year spread was unchanged from the prior week at 80 basis points.
